name: FONBET
verdict: The KHL's press service names Valentin Golovanov as FONBET's managing shareholder. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Russian private betting company; title partner of the KHL since the 2022/23 season (the championship carries the FONBET name; deal extended to the end of 2027/28, khl.ru 2026-09-21) and an Avangard club partner listed on the club's partners page. Managing shareholder named by the KHL's press service; no state link and no abuse record found.
